about.title: Needles Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Needles sits along a stretch of San Bernardino County where Interstate 40's eastbound and westbound lanes, Route 95, and Needles Highway carry a steady mix of long-haul trucks, RVs, and local traffic. Public records show 16 injury collisions and 22 injured people in the most recent final crash year, with reports tending to cluster on Thursday afternoons between noon and 2 p.m. — a pattern worth knowing if you're piecing together what happened in your own crash. Whether you were rear-ended near a highway interchange or sideswiped on Needles Highway, the aftermath often means medical appointments, missed work, and calls from an insurance adjuster who wants a statement. We handle personal injury claims directly, reviewing the facts, explaining your options under California law, and managing communication with insurers while you focus on recovering.
commonInjuries: Lacerations from broken glass or debris

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to an Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident claim in California, but if a government entity — like a county road crew — may be involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. We can help identify which deadline applies to your situation early.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Into Your Claim
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of fault can reduce what you're able to collect. Having someone evaluate the evidence — skid marks, dashcam footage, witness accounts — before the insurer forms its own narrative matters.

items.title: Recorded Statements Can Work Against You
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement quickly, sometimes before you've seen a doctor or understand the full extent of your injuries. We can speak on your behalf so nothing you say is used to minimize a legitimate claim.

items.question: I was in a crash on I-40 near Needles — what should I do first?
items.answer: Seek medical care first, even if injuries seem minor, since some symptoms show up later. Try to document the scene with photos if you're able, and avoid giving a recorded statement to any insurance company until you've spoken with an attorney. We can handle these calls for you.

items.question: Does it cost anything to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our consultation is free, and we typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. You pay nothing out of pocket for an initial conversation about your case.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a Needles car accident?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit, but claims involving a government entity — such as a road maintained by the county — can require notice within as little as six months. Because Needles has both state highways and local roads, it's worth confirming which timeline applies to your specific crash sooner rather than later.
